meta.name: paper-context-resolver
meta.description: Rigor Paper Context helper for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use only when the README and repository files leave a narrow reproduction-critical gap and the task is to resolve a specific paper detail such as dataset split, preprocessing, evaluation protocol, checkpoint mapping, or runtime assumption from primary paper sources while recording conflicts. Do not use for general paper summary, repo scanning, environment setup, command execution, title-only paper lookup, or replacing README guidance by default.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从论文原文补全复现缺失的细节
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果论文代码的README缺少关键细节，需要从原文查证。
copy.tagline_en: Resolve missing reproduction details from paper sources
copy.fit_line_en: For you if the README lacks critical details for reproducing a paper and you need to consult the original source.

howto.what: 当你在复现深度学习论文时，如果 README 和代码文件缺少关键细节（如数据集划分、预处理方式等），Claude 会从原始论文中提取这些具体信息，并指出与 README 的冲突。
howto.when: 在根据 README 复现代码时，遇到 README 未说明或与论文不一致的关键细节，且你有具体的复现问题时触发。

say.text: 这个数据集在论文里是用哪个划分的？
say.note: Claude 会从论文中查找数据集划分方式。

say.text: 论文里的评估指标和 README 说的不一样，帮我核对一下。

howto.what_en: When reproducing a deep learning paper, if the README and repository files lack critical details (e.g., dataset split, preprocessing), Claude extracts those specifics from the original paper and notes conflicts with the README.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the README leaves a reproduction-critical gap and you have a concrete question about a paper detail like dataset split, preprocessing, or evaluation protocol.

say_en.text: Which dataset split does the paper use?
say_en.note: Claude looks up the split from the paper.

say_en.text: The evaluation metrics in the paper differ from the README; please reconcile.
say_en.note: Claude compares and records the conflict.
